tooltip.midicraft.mod_enabled: Note block labels, scroll-to-retune and the placement sequence. The Composer works either way.
tooltip.midicraft.debug_commands: Adds /midicraft paste and asciidiagram. Syntax in the README.
tooltip.midicraft.radial_focus_delay: Ticks the center label must stay under the crosshair before its radial opens and accepts scrolling. 0 opens immediately.
tooltip.midicraft.repeater_control_style: Radial select shows a four-number diamond and lets either wheel direction confirm a hovered delay. Scroll uses one number with directional cycling.
tooltip.midicraft.invert_scroll: Makes wheel-down raise the selected pitch instead of wheel-up.
tooltip.midicraft.view_distance: Maximum distance at which note and repeater labels are shown.
tooltip.midicraft.interaction_delay: Extra ticks between tuning interactions. 0 restores the original maximum of one interaction per client tick.
tooltip.midicraft.wait_for_ack: Waits for the changed block state to return from the server before sending the next interaction. Safer on restrictive or laggy servers, but slower.
tooltip.midicraft.require_line_of_sight: Cancels tuning if another block obstructs the path from your eyes to the target block. Disabled by default.
tooltip.midicraft.sequence_enabled: Runs or pauses the placement sequence without resetting its position, which is remembered per song. Double-tap the sequence key to switch between running and paused.
tooltip.midicraft.sequencing_edit_protec: While a nonempty sequence is running, disables overlay editing and optionally blocks ordinary right-click changes to existing note blocks and repeaters. Sneak-placement and automatic tuning remain available.
tooltip.midicraft.select_harp_blocks: Whether harp notes also ask for grass or dirt when Select instruments is on.
tooltip.midicraft.chord_place_order: The order the sequence walks a chord's notes. Doesn't change the build.
tooltip.midicraft.select_instruments: Makes the block under each note its own sequence step.
tooltip.midicraft.auto_select_sequence_b: Selects a note block or repeater from your hotbar whenever the current sequence step changes, including manual scrolling.
tooltip.midicraft.max_build_floors: Most floors a Compact cube build can stack. More floors, smaller footprint.
tooltip.midicraft.commands_per_tick: How fast pasting places blocks. High rates can get you kicked on servers.
tooltip.midicraft.midi_quantize_grid: The grid Convert snaps notes to. Auto reads it from the song.
tooltip.midicraft.midi_instrument_source: Where imported tracks get their instrument: the file, track names, or always the default.
option.midicraft.convert_octave_shifting: Shift the layer, then the notes
tooltip.midicraft.convert_octave_shiftin:
How Convert fixes out-of-range notes.
Shift the notes: only the stray notes move.
Shift the layer: the whole layer moves.
Split into melodic: strays go to a new melodic layer.
Convert to melodic: the whole part becomes one.
tooltip.midicraft.convert_split_transpos: Puts notes Convert moved by an octave on their own layer, so you can see them.
tooltip.midicraft.conversion_gap_percent: How many tight note pairs the Auto grid may ignore, so a few don't slow the whole song.
tooltip.midicraft.repeat_merge_ticks: Convert merges repeats of a pitch closer than this many repeater ticks. 0 keeps all.
tooltip.midicraft.midi_velocity_cutoff: Drops imported notes quieter than this. Off by default.
tooltip.midicraft.chord_thin_target: Most note blocks a chord may use. Bigger chords are thinned by the settings below.
tooltip.midicraft.chord_thin_volume: Plays counted instruments (like harp ×3) with fewer copies in big chords.
tooltip.midicraft.chord_thin_strikes: On a chord still over the target, skip a sustain strike. The held note rings on from the strike before, and never loses two in a row. Nothing is deleted.
tooltip.midicraft.midi_ignore_percussion: Skips MIDI channel 10, which is usually drums.
tooltip.midicraft.midi_default_instrumen: Instrument id used for imported tracks, such as HARP, BASS, BELL, FLUTE, or MUTE.
error.midicraft.sequence: Notes must be 0-24 and repeater delay groups must be 1d-64d.
tooltip.midicraft.lane_one_block: Lane floor for the first machine. Needs a top dust can stand on.
tooltip.midicraft.lane_two_block: Lane floor for the second machine.
tooltip.midicraft.relay_block: Lane cells that carry power. Must conduct redstone.
tooltip.midicraft.transparent_block: The climbs between floors. Must not conduct redstone.
tooltip.midicraft.support_block: The level under a floor: what holds up falling instruments, dust and the bottom rail's repeaters. Needs a solid top. A slab is laid as its top half. Nothing here carries power.
tooltip.midicraft.thin_lane_block: Dust floor when lanes are packed one block apart. Must not conduct redstone.
tooltip.midicraft.nearby_overlays: Labels every nearby block of these types. Read-only.
tooltip.midicraft.interactive_overlays: The overlay on the block you're aiming at. Scroll to retune.
tooltip.midicraft.interactive_overlay_ty: Which block types the interactive overlay answers for. Narrow it to repeaters if scrolling note blocks by accident is the problem, or the other way about.
tooltip.midicraft.composer_gui_scale: GUI scale for this mod's screens, separate from Minecraft's.
